findings.title: README stale finding count — 52 open findings claim outdated since index.json shows 0 open
findings.detail: README line 45 stated '52 open findings (6 CRITICAL / 37 IMPORTANT / 9 COSMETIC) as of 2026-05-21' but as of 2026-06-02 index.json reports open_findings: 0. Stale headline count undermines trust in the document accuracy.
findings.fix_sketch: Update the headline to reflect current state and clarify that 52 was the initial baseline count.

findings.title: Phase 2 status shows ambiguous 🟡 'file-level only' instead of 🔴 BLOCKED
findings.detail: README Phase 2 row showed '🟡 file-level only — Codex CLI not installed'. The 🟡 emoji implies in-progress, but the reality is BLOCKED pending Sebastian setup. Misleading status affects sprint planning decisions.
findings.fix_sketch: Change to 🔴 BLOCKED with explicit note that Codex CLI setup is required.

findings.title: plan.md schema lists fixed and closed status values without defining the distinction
findings.detail: The status field in plan.md schema shows 'open|fixing|verifying|fixed|closed|regression' but nowhere explains that fixed = PR merged (fix live) and closed = ledger entry written to closed.json. Implementers seeing both values would not know when to use which.
findings.fix_sketch: Add a status lifecycle table after the schema block documenting each value, who writes it, and what it means.
